warnTrash: Current files in {path} will be moved to the File Manager trash.
warnPhp: Website PHP will switch from {from} to {to}.
rootTrash: Current files in the project root will be moved to the File Manager trash.
docRoot: The document root will be set to {path}.
servedFromRoot: The site is served from the project root.

db.title: Database
db.createNewHelp: A fresh database and user for this website

engine.title: Database engine
engine.pgMissing: PostgreSQL is not installed on this server.
engine.pgOff: PostgreSQL is turned off. Turn it on under Database Management → PostgreSQL before installing.

laravel.title: Laravel Installer
laravel.subtitle: Install a fresh Laravel project with a database for {domain}.
laravel.pushHelp: Only if the repository is still empty: the new project becomes its first commit. .env, vendor and node_modules are not pushed.
laravel.dbReuse: {engine} database {name} will be reused and wiped by migrate:fresh.
laravel.dbNew: A new {engine} database {name} will be created for {domain}.
laravel.pgNote: Laravel connects with DB_CONNECTION=pgsql; the site's PHP needs the pdo_pgsql extension.
laravel.slow: Composer and the frontend build can take several minutes.

stage.finalizing: Switching PHP version and document root…
stage.pushingGit: Pushing the project to the connected repository…

wordpress.title: WordPress Installer
wordpress.subtitle: Install WordPress with automatic database provisioning for {domain}.
wordpress.existingNote: Reused as-is; WordPress tables use the prefix below
wordpress.phpAuto: PHP will be switched automatically from {from} to {to}.
wordpress.phpOutOfRange: Current PHP {version} is out of range; {action} switches it to the newest compatible installed PHP.
wordpress.phpNone: No compatible PHP is installed on this server — install one in PHP Manager or pick another version.
wordpress.prefixDb: Tables are created in {name}; existing tables with another prefix are left alone.

app.title: {app} Installer
app.noteJoomla: Existing tables are kept; Joomla uses a new table prefix
app.noteDrupal: All tables will be dropped by the installer

stage.downloadDrupal: Downloading Drupal and Drush with Composer…
stage.configureDrupal: Writing settings.php and running drush site:install…
stage.finalizing: Setting permissions, PHP version and document root…

whmcs.title: WHMCS package & license
whmcs.help: Download the full WHMCS zip from your WHMCS client area (Services → your license → Downloads) and upload it here.
whmcs.note: Needs the ionCube Loader for PHP {php}. The install/ folder is removed, a 5-minute cron for crons/cron.php is added, and the admin area is /admin.

app.noteDrush: Drush is added to the project (vendor/bin/drush). Log in at /user/login.
app.noteJoomlaAdmin: The installation/ folder is removed after setup. Admin panel: /administrator.
